scenario: [LUNI.2.4.1], with [LUNI.3.3]: a negated unit literal is held to the 64-bit signed range by its negated value, and one below it is refused at the literal with DS_VALIDATE_CONSTANT_OUT_OF_RANGE. `byte` is `x * 8` bits on an `int64` dimension, and `-1152921504606846977_byte` is -2^63 - 8 bits, past the bottom. A compiler that admits every negated literal without judging it wraps the value to 9223372036854775800 and compiles. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck.lnul_5_2_unnarrowed_type`'s unary arm, which sends a minus over a non-time `ex_unit` to `luni_3_1_7_literal_type` as `negated`, through `dsc.quantity.quantity_base`, `dsc.quantity.luni_2_4_1_literal_out_of_range` and `dsc.exact.luni_2_4_1_int64`; `dsc.quantity.is_whole` judges the value whole, so DS_VALIDATE_UNIT_LITERAL_NOT_WHOLE does not take it.
rules_ds:
unit dimension data storage int64 base bit
unit bit: data
unit byte: data = x * 8

schema Blob scope logical:
    id: Int key
    size: bit mutable

rule r:
    Blob b where b.size > -1152921504606846977_byte
->
    log info "big"
